opening.argument: The video describes a creator-run subscriber milestone giveaway for one $50 Nike gift card, and the title identifies that giveaway as closed. Entry requires a viewer to comment the creator's city and state and provide an external contact method, while correct entries are placed into a randomizer for one winner. Those requirements are presented as ordinary contest administration, not as a payment demand or credential request. Nothing described establishes deceptive claims, a delivery outcome, or a connection between subscription prompts and a financial offer. The stated process is therefore a conventional loyalty and promotional drawing, with the contact information used to facilitate possible winner contact.

citations.quote: Now for my 500 subscriber giveaway, I want to give away a $50 Nike gift card.
To enter you must comment in the comment section below what city and state I live in.
All correct entries will be put into a randomizer and winner will be chosen on Sunday February 26, 2017.
